control.description-key: PBS Hub Ops Console: the brands and the accounts of every brand. Add a brand, add an account (code, name, brand, platform, active) and edit an account.

property.name: Context
property.description-key: JSON {userEmail,userName,roles,permissions,config}. config.platforms: optional list of platforms offered when adding an account (default Shopee, TikTok). Writing needs BRAND_EDIT (without a permission list: PBS_Team and FAS_Team).

property.name: BrandsJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Brand - PBS Hub]: ID, Title (brand code), NamaBrand.

property.name: AccountsJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Account - PBS Hub]: ID, Title (account code), AccountName, BrandID (= Brand.Title), Platform (Choice, send .Value), Status (Choice Active / Inactive, send .Value), Modified.

property.name: BrandId
property.description-key: Optional Brand.Title to select when the screen opens. Empty: all brands.

property.name: IsLoading
property.description-key: true while canvas is loading: renders skeleton rows.

property.name: ActionResult
property.description-key: Canvas reply {requestId,status,message}. ADD_BRAND, ADD_ACCOUNT and UPDATE_ACCOUNT lock until it comes back.

property.name: ActionPayload
property.description-key: JSON {action,requestId,payload}: ADD_BRAND, ADD_ACCOUNT, UPDATE_ACCOUNT, BRAND_SELECTED, FILTER_CHANGED.
